title: API & SDK Quickstart Illustration Pack — auth, streaming, and tool-calling visuals
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Background: The docs quickstart pages (API + SDK) are being consolidated for the April docs release. Current quickstarts lack cohesive visuals for: API key lifecycle, auth flows (OAuth / API key), token usage for hosted vs private deployments, streaming/websocket examples, and function/tool calling sequences. Goal: produce a cohesive illustration pack and annotated screenshot set designers/docs writers can drop into quickstart guides and SDK README templates.

Scope of work:
- Hero quickstart graphic: simplified flow from ‘Create key’ -> ‘Call API’ -> ‘Receive streaming response’ with pinned console UI thumbnail. Provide SVG+PNG exports.
- Auth & Keys diagram: two variants (hosted API keys; private/VPC with KMS) showing issuance, rotation, and least-privilege tips. Include alt text and short copy callouts.
- Streaming sequence diagram: client SDK -> websocket/stream endpoint -> partial tokens -> client render; show reconnection/backoff and chunked function-calling.
- Tool-calling flow: sequence diagram for model invoking external tool via function calling (tool discovery, call schema, response mapping). Visuals must include both sync and async tool invocation.
- Console screenshots: updated API Keys page annotated (callout pins for scope, expiry, copy button). SDK snippet screenshot showing minimal streaming loop and function-calling helpers. Provide dark & light variants, mobile breakpoint crops.
- Export deliverables: master Figma file, individual SVGs (vector), PNGs at 2x and 3x for hero and diagrams, single framed screenshots (PNG), and compressed web-optimized PNG/JPEG for docs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each diagram has clear alt text (one-liners) and suggested caption text for docs.
- All visuals follow brand color tokens and meet 4.5:1 contrast for any instructional text overlays.
- Figma file includes componentized pieces (icons, connectors) so docs team can swap copy.
- Assets exported with filenames following convention: docs_quickstart_<type>_<variant>_<size>.svg/png.
- Mocked screenshots wired to latest console layout (console-2026.02) and approved by PM.

Accessibility & localization notes:
- Keep embedded text minimal; use callouts in docs for long explanations.
- Prepare separate exported comps with no embedded copy for translators.

Design decisions and trade-offs:
- Chose simplified sequence diagrams over fully annotated swimlanes to keep images compact for mobile.
- For streaming graphic we will use progressive token bar rather than literal token-by-token text to avoid language-specific leakage.

File naming & storage:
- Master Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/redwood-docs-quickstart-2026
- Exported asset bucket (GDrive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDACTED/quickstart-assets-2026

Notes to engineering/docs:
- ENG-2411 will provide up-to-date console mock endpoints for screenshots; wait for ENG-2490 to land streaming SDK sample (target 2026-03-16).
- PM review required for key rotation copy and compliance check for KMS imagery.

Deliverable checklist:
- [ ] Figma master with componentized layers
- [ ] Hero SVG + PNG 2x/3x
- [ ] Auth/key diagram SVG + PNGs (hosted & private variants)
- [ ] Streaming seq SVG + PNGs (desktop/mobile crops)
- [ ] Tool-calling seq SVG + PNGs (sync + async)
- [ ] Annotated console screenshots (dark/light/mobile)
- [ ] Alt text + suggested captions CSV
- [ ] Upload to Drive and link to docs repo PR
